rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Ой! Снег! Где наш росток?
rows.text: Oh! Snow! Where's our sprout?
rows.heard: Oh, snow! Where's our sprout?

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Нашёл! Смотри́те! Вот наш росток!
rows.text: Found it! Look! Here's our sprout!
rows.heard: Found it, look, here's our sprout.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Он зелёный! Сидел под снегом и не замё́рз!
rows.text: It's green! It was under the snow and didn't freeze!
rows.heard: It's green. It was under the snow and didn't freeze.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Ночью был мороз. А ему́ хоть бы что!
rows.text: It was freezing last night. But it's just fine!
rows.heard: It was freezing last night, but it's just fine.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Как же он не замё́рз? Ему́ же холодно!
rows.text: How did it not freeze? It's so cold!
rows.heard: How did it not freeze? It's so cold.

rows.name: Рассказчик
rows.ru: Рон достал из рюкзака красную подушку.
rows.text: Ron took a red pillow out of his backpack.
rows.heard: Ron took a red pillow out of his backpack.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Держись, малыш! Вот тебе подушка. Мя́гкая!
rows.text: Hang on, little one! Here's a pillow. It's soft!
rows.heard: Hang on, little one. Here's a pillow. It's soft.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Рон, у ростка есть одеяло.
rows.text: Ron, the sprout has a blanket.
rows.heard: Ron, the Sprout has a blanket.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Где? Я ничего не вижу.
rows.text: Where? I don't see anything.
rows.heard: Where? I don't see anything.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Вот оно. Снег!
rows.text: Right here. Snow!
rows.heard: Right here, snow.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Снег? Но снег холодный!
rows.text: Snow? But snow is cold!
rows.heard: Snow but snow is cold.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: И он совсем целый!
rows.text: And it's not hurt at all!
rows.heard: and it's not hurt at all.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Вот это загадка. Холодный снег, а под ним росток не мёрзнет.
rows.text: What a mystery. Cold snow, but the sprout under it doesn't freeze.
rows.heard: What a mystery. Cold snow, but the sprout under it doesn't freeze.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Может, снег не такой уж холодный?
rows.text: Maybe snow isn't so cold after all?
rows.heard: Maybe snow isn't so cold after all.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Топа, ты зеваешь уже́ десятый раз!
rows.text: Topa, that's your tenth yawn!
rows.heard: Topa, that's your 10th yawn.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Не знаю почему. Зимой мне всё время хочется спать.
rows.text: I don't know why. In winter I always feel so sleepy.
rows.heard: I don't know why. In winter I always feel so sleepy.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Это потому, что ты медвежонок. Медве́ди спят всю зи́му!
rows.text: Because you're a bear cub. Bears sleep all winter!
rows.heard: Because you're a bear cub, bear sleep all winter.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Всю зи́му? А как же завтрак?
rows.text: All winter? What about breakfast?
rows.heard: All winter, what about breakfast?

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Осенью медве́ди много едят. А пото́м спят и не голодают.
rows.text: In autumn bears eat a lot. Then they sleep and don't get hungry.
rows.heard: In autumn bears eat a lot, then they sleep and don't get hungry.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Как жёлудь! Запас еды на пото́м!
rows.text: Like an acorn! Food saved for later!
rows.heard: Like an acorn, food saved for later.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Тогда мне тоже нужен запас. Начну прямо сейчас.
rows.text: Then I need a food stash too. I'll start right now.
rows.heard: Then I need a food stash too. I'll start right now.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Всё! Запас готов. Я тоже буду спать всю зи́му!
rows.text: Done! My stash is ready. I'll sleep all winter too!
rows.heard: Done, my stash is ready. I'll sleep all winter too.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Спокойной ночи!
rows.text: Good night!
rows.heard: Good night.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Всё! Я выспался! Можно завтракать?
rows.text: Done! I'm all rested! Can we have breakfast?
rows.heard: Done, I'm all rested. Can we have breakfast?

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Рон, прошла одна минутка!
rows.text: Ron, it's been one minute!
rows.heard: Ron, it's been one minute.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: А где медве́ди спят?
rows.text: Where do bears sleep?
rows.heard: Where do bears sleep?

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: В берлоге. Это ямка под ёлкой. Сверху её засыпает снег.
rows.text: In a den. It's a little hole under a fir tree. Snow covers it on top.
rows.heard: In a den, it's a little hole under a fir tree. Snow covers it on top.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: В берлоге тепло, даже когда снаружи сильный мороз.
rows.text: It's warm in the den, even when it's freezing outside.
rows.heard: It's warm in the den, even when it's freezing outside.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Опять снег гре́ет?
rows.text: Snow warms it again?
rows.heard: Snow warms it again.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Снег сам не гре́ет. Он как шарф. Шарф не печка, а нам в нём тепло.
rows.text: Snow doesn't make heat. It's like a scarf. A scarf isn't a stove, but we're warm in it.
rows.heard: Snow doesn't make heat, it's like a scarf. A scarf isn't a stove, but we're warm in it.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Потому что шарф не выпускает наше тепло?
rows.text: Because the scarf keeps our warmth in?
rows.heard: because the scarf keeps our warmth in.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Да! В снегу много воздуха. И он бережёт тепло земли́. Как пуши́стое одеяло.
rows.text: Yes! Snow is full of air. It keeps the ground warm. Like a fluffy blanket.
rows.heard: Yes, snow is full of air. It keeps the ground warm like a fluffy blanket.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Значит, росток спит под одеялом. Как Топа!
rows.text: So the sprout sleeps under a blanket. Like Topa!
rows.heard: so the sprout sleeps under a blanket, like Topa.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Ти́ше. Топа уже́ спит.
rows.text: Shh. Topa's already asleep.
rows.heard: SHH. Topaz already asleep.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Смотри́те, ёлки зелёные! Зимой!
rows.text: Look, the fir trees are green! In winter!
rows.heard: Look the fir trees are green in winter.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: У ёлки иголки. Тонкие и крепкие. Им мороз не страшен.
rows.text: Fir trees have needles. Thin and strong. Frost can't hurt them.
rows.heard: Fur trees have needles, thin and strong, frost can't hurt them.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: А вот листик дуба. Он сухой и коричневый.
rows.text: And here's an oak leaf. It's dry and brown.
rows.heard: And here's an oak leaf. It's dry and brown.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Осенью дуб сбрасывает листья. И засыпает до весны.
rows.text: In autumn the oak drops its leaves. And sleeps until spring.
rows.heard: In autumn the oak drought its leaves and sleeps until spring.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Дуб тоже медве́дь?
rows.text: Oak's a bear?
rows.heard: A loax of bear.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Нет. Но спит он, как я!
rows.text: No. But it sleeps like me!
rows.heard: No, but it sleeps like me.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Смотри́те! Жёлудь! Прямо под снегом!
rows.text: Look! An acorn! Right under the snow!
rows.heard: look an acorn right under the snow.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Он тоже спит. Как наш росток.
rows.text: It's sleeping too. Like our sprout.
rows.heard: It's sleeping too, like our sprout.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: А весной снег раста́ет. И жёлудь проснётся.
rows.text: In spring the snow will melt. And the acorn will wake up.
rows.heard: In spring, the snow will melt, and the acorn will wake up.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Так долго ждать?
rows.text: That long?
rows.heard: Did that long?

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Ничего. Мы подождём вместе.
rows.text: That's okay. We'll wait together.
rows.heard: That's okay. We'll wait together.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: А давайте пока в прятки! Рон водит!
rows.text: Let's play hide-and-seek! Ron is it!
rows.heard: Let's play hide and seek. Ron is it.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Раз, два, три! Иду искать!
rows.text: One, two, three! Here I come!
rows.heard: One, two, three, here I come.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Где Филя? Тут только снег!
rows.text: Where's Filya? There's only snow!
rows.heard: Where's Billy? There's only snow.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Ой! Филя! Ты белый, как снег!
rows.text: Oh! Filya! You're white as snow!
rows.heard: Oh, Philia, you're white as snow.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Зайцы к зиме становятся белыми. На снегу их не ви́дно.
rows.text: Hares turn white in winter. You can't see them on the snow.
rows.heard: Hairs turn white in winter. You can't see them on the snow.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: А я белый всегда. Я готов к зиме заранее!
rows.text: But I'm always white. I'm ready for winter ahead of time!
rows.heard: But I'm always white. I'm ready for winter ahead of time.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Я придумал! Росток будет охранять снежный сторож!
rows.text: I've got an idea! A snow guard will protect the sprout!
rows.heard: I've got an idea. A snow guard will protect the sprout.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Готово! Вот он, снежный сторож! Он не мёрзнет и никогда не спит!
rows.text: Done! Here he is, the snow guard! He never gets cold and never sleeps!
rows.heard: Done, here he is, the snow guard. He never gets cold and never sleeps.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Повезло́ ему́.
rows.text: Lucky him.
rows.heard: Lucky him.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: А ну, кто поймает?
rows.text: Who can catch it?
rows.heard: Who can catch it?

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Поймал! Я быстрый сторож!
rows.text: Got it! I'm a fast guard!
rows.heard: Got it! I'm a fast guard!

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Мимо!
rows.text: Missed!
rows.heard: Missed.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Это я ему́ показал, как надо.
rows.text: I was showing him how it's done.
rows.heard: I was showing him how it's done.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Тёплое молоко. И сразу хочется спать.
rows.text: Warm milk. And right away I'm sleepy.
rows.heard: warm milk, and right away I'm sleepy.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Нам тепло в доме. А ростку тепло под снегом.
rows.text: We're warm in the house. And the sprout is warm under the snow.
rows.heard: We're warm in the house, and the sprout is warm under the snow.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: А наш снежный сторож? Ему́ тоже тепло?
rows.text: What about our snow guard? Is he warm too?
rows.heard: What about our snow guard? Is he warm too?

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Ему́ нельзя гре́ться. Он раста́ет.
rows.text: He can't get warm. He'll melt.
rows.heard: He can't get warm, he'll melt.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Тогда пусть ему́ будет холодно! Самую чуточку.
rows.text: Then let him be cold! Just a tiny bit.
rows.heard: Then let him be cold, just a tiny bit.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Давайте поиграем! Я спрашиваю, а вы отвечаете.
rows.text: Let's play a game! I ask, and you answer.
rows.heard: Let's play a game I ask and you answer.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Начинай!
rows.text: Go ahead!
rows.heard: Go ahead.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Почему росток под снегом не замё́рз?
rows.text: Why didn't the sprout freeze under the snow?
rows.heard: Why didn't the sprout freeze under the snow?

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Его укрыл снег, как одеяло.
rows.text: Snow covered it like a blanket.
rows.heard: Snow covered it like a blanket.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Правильно! А кто спит всю зи́му?
rows.text: Right! Who sleeps all winter?
rows.heard: Right who sleeps all winter.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Медве́ди. И я.
rows.text: Bears. And me.
rows.heard: bears and me.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: А почему ёлка зимой зелёная?
rows.text: Why is the fir tree green in winter?
rows.heard: Why is the fir tree green in winter?

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: У неё иголки. Им мороз не страшен.
rows.text: It has needles. Frost can't hurt them.
rows.heard: It has needles, frost can't hurt them.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: А кто никогда не спит?
rows.text: Who never sleeps?
rows.heard: Who never sleeps.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Кто?
rows.text: Who?
rows.heard: Heel.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Снежный сторож! И я! Почти.
rows.text: The snow guard! And me! Almost.
rows.heard: The snow guard and me almost.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Вот наш росток. Спит под одеялом.
rows.text: Here's our sprout. Sleeping under its blanket.
rows.heard: Here's our sprout, sleeping under its blanket.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: А вот и снеговик. Сторожит.
rows.text: And here's the snowman. On guard.
rows.heard: And here's the snowman on guard.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Мы с ним вдвоём. Я и мой помощник.
rows.text: Just the two of us. Me and my helper.
rows.heard: Just the two of us, me and my helper.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Сторож, ты точно не спишь?
rows.text: Guard, are you really awake?
rows.heard: Guard, are you really awake?

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Он молчит. Значит, сторожит.
rows.text: He's quiet. So he's on guard.
rows.heard: He's quiet, so he's on guard.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Тогда я закрою один глаз. Только один.
rows.text: Then I'll close one eye. Just one.
rows.heard: Then I'll close one eye, just one.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Спокойной ночи, сторож.
rows.text: Good night, guard.
rows.heard: Good night, guard.

rows.name: Рассказчик
rows.ru: Снег кончился.
rows.text: The snow stopped.
rows.heard: The snow stopped.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Я не спал! Я сторожил вместе с помощником!
rows.text: I wasn't sleeping! I was on guard with my helper!
rows.heard: I wasn't sleeping. I was on guard with my helper.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Ура, со́лнце вышло! Сегодня оно́ гре́ет.
rows.text: Hooray, the sun is out! It's warm today.
rows.heard: Hurray the sun is out! It's warm today!

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Смотри́те, вот наш снеговик. Он блестит на со́лнце.
rows.text: Look, there's our snowman. He's sparkling in the sun.
rows.heard: Look, there's our snowman. He's sparkling in the sun.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Если станет тепло, снег начнёт таять.
rows.text: If it gets warm, the snow will start to melt.
rows.heard: If it gets warm, the snow will start to melt.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: А мой сторож? Он же снежный!
rows.text: And my guard? He's made of snow!
rows.heard: And my guard, he's made of snow.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Ой. Он тоже раста́ет?
rows.text: Oh. Will he melt too?
rows.heard: Oh, will he melt too?

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Не отдам! Он мой сторож!
rows.text: You can't have him! He's my guard!
rows.heard: You can't have him. He's my guard.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Не знаю, Рон. Это новая загадка.
rows.text: I don't know, Ron. That's a new mystery.
rows.heard: I don't know, Ron. That's a new mystery.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Завтра узнаем, куда уходят снеговики.
rows.text: Tomorrow we'll find out where snowmen go.
rows.heard: Tomorrow we'll find out where snowmen go.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Понравился мультик? Попроси маму или папу поставить лайк и подписаться на канал. До встречи в новой серии!
rows.text: Did you like the cartoon? Ask mom or dad to like it and subscribe to the channel. See you in the next episode!
rows.heard: Did you like the cartoon? Ask mom or dad to like it and subscribe to the channel. See you in the next episode.
